title: Rotation, balance and flat repair
facts: Menu jobs tyre_rotation (0.3 h), wheel_balance (0.6 h), tyre_repair (0.3 h).
Rotation rides on 23.4 % of orders ("nearly one in four").
Balance for a shake at 55 to 70 mph; a shake under braking is rotors.
Repair rules: tread only, small hole, patch-plug from inside.

list_items.item: Rotation with every other oil change. Nearly one order in four has one on it. Lugs are torqued by hand and the customer is told so.
Balance when the wheel shakes at 55 to 70 mph. A shake only under braking is rotors, not balance: Brake inspection.

Flat repair only in the tread, only a hole smaller than a pencil, only from the inside with a patch-plug. Never a plug from outside, never the sidewall or shoulder. If it cannot be repaired the customer is shown why, and the next page is New tires.
A tire driven on flat for any distance is usually ruined inside. Look before you promise a repair.
